title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeFunctionServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ComputeFunctionServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and providing compute functions capabilities. Subclass of ComputeServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ComputeServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeFunctionServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

computeFunctionConfiguration.description: Relationship. Attributes configurable at service instantiation. Links to a ComputeFunctionConfiguration entity.

computeFunctionDebugTools.description: Property. Indicates whether the service includes debugging tools.

computeFunctionEditor.description: Property. Indicates whether the service includes a code editor.

computeFunctionAllowQuota.description: Property. Indicates whether the service allows defining resource quotas for functions (typically memory).

computeFunctionAllowTimeout.description: Property. Indicates whether the service allows defining timeouts for functions.

computeFunctionAllowVersioning.description: Property. Indicates whether the service allows code versioning for functions.

computeFunctionAllowAutoScaling.description: Property. Indicates whether the service supports auto-scaling of functions.

computeFunctionAllowFSMount.description: Property. Indicates whether the service supports mounting and using external file systems in functions.
